source: Therefore four blocks are resident in this simplified model, or 4ZXMATH0000XZ8 = 32 warps, and occupancy is 32ZXMATH0001XZ If shared memory were reduced to 16 KiB, occupancy would not automatically rise: registers would still cap residency at four blocks. Optimizing the non-limiting resource changes nothing. This is exactly why occupancy analysis must identify the active constraint rather than tune one number in isolation.[2,3]
zh: 因此，在此简化模型中驻留有四个块，即 4ZXMATH0000XZ8 = 32 个扭曲，占用率为 32ZXMATH0001XZ 如果共享内存减少到 16 KiB，占用率不会自动上升：寄存器仍会将驻留限制为四个块。优化非限制性资源不会改变任何事情。这正是占用分析必须识别主动约束而不是单独调整一个数字的原因。[2,3]
